description: Columbia, S.C. – State Representative Randy Ligon (R – District 43) joined Governor Henry McMaster, leaders from the S.C. Department of Natural Resources, key legislators, and other stakeholders today at Columbia’s Riverbanks Zoo and Gardens for a formal bill-signing ceremony to commemorate Act 177 of the 2020 legislative session.
